The main takeaway from our work is that

WEE1 rs 3910384 genotype is a selective biomarker that can be used for NSCLC treatment with doublet DNA-damaging chemotherapy regimen, i.e. gemcitabine plus platinum, but not with other chemotherapy regimens.
